deliverables.name: CLI contract and input/output requirements
acceptance_criteria: Specify commands, arguments, help/examples, stdout/stderr and exit statuses.
Document local input constraints and non-destructive behavior.

deliverables.name: Minimal offline architecture and dependency decisions
acceptance_criteria: Use the smallest modular structure that meets file-processing needs.
Do not add authentication, database, network services, or queue infrastructure.

deliverables.name: Scoped implementation plan
acceptance_criteria: Use reviewable changes and explicit dependencies.
Keep all writes non-destructive unless separately authorized.

deliverables.name: Requirements-linked CLI tests and gate evidence
acceptance_criteria: Define CLI argument/stdout/stderr/exit-status cases with controlled local filesystem fixture files and error-path inputs.
Execute tests before claiming outcomes; record candidate and results.

deliverables.name: Conditional packaging and local recovery approach
acceptance_criteria: Decide packaging only after target platforms and distribution are known.
If writes become authorized, define local backup/recovery and verify it; no service rollback/deployment.
Do not claim any release occurred.
